# Levels and trust

The words by feature level (`lib/src/core/levels.dart`, the same table as the JSON reference's levels.md). A level is a closed set: a document that uses one level's words uses nothing from a higher one. Open it when you are given a level, or a trust profile, to write within.

<a id="levels-trust"></a>
## Trust

A host checks what an agent writes against a trust profile (`lib/src/core/edit/trust.dart`). What it refuses is reported, not drawn: write within it.

|  | `TrustProfile.agent` (the default for agent-written UI) |
|---|---|
| Words (node types) | The core catalog's: every type of levels 0 to 4 but the feature layers' (66 types). |
| Actions | [`navigate`](events.md#action-navigate), [`openModal`](events.md#action-openModal), [`closeModal`](events.md#action-closeModal), [`retryFailed`](events.md#action-retryFailed), [`setValue`](events.md#action-setValue), [`setVariant`](events.md#action-setVariant), [`setVariable`](events.md#action-setVariable), [`if`](events.md#action-if), [`forEach`](events.md#action-forEach), [`announce`](events.md#action-announce), [`showToast`](events.md#action-showToast), [`confirm`](events.md#action-confirm), [`delay`](events.md#action-delay), [`focus`](events.md#action-focus), [`scrollTo`](events.md#action-scrollTo), [`animate`](events.md#action-animate), [`haptic`](events.md#action-haptic), [`paginate`](events.md#action-paginate), [`componentEvent`](events.md#action-componentEvent) |
| Not allowed | `openLink`, `callFunction`, `copyToClipboard`, `setThemeMode`, `editText`, `validate`, `controlTrack`, `controlDismissible`, `controlTransform`, `runScript`, `callApi`, `setStorage`, `cloudDocuments`, `loadCloudData`, `reloadCloudData`, `cloudFiles`, `cloudData`, `cloudBatch`, `submitForm`, `auth`, `paywall`, `print`, `preloadImages`, `speak`, `playSound`, `captureScreenshot`, `downloadFile`, `emitEvent` |
| Scripts | no (`runScript`, `script.x(…)`); `TrustProfile.agentApps` allows a document's own sandboxed scripts |
| Links | none |
| Navigation | `withinDocument` |
| Limits | nodes 1500, depth 40, text 4000 characters |
